description: This file contains functions for managing calendar events, including processing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving calendar data, with integrations and credential handling.

classes.name: ConnectedCalendar
classes.description: Type representing a connected calendar with additional metadata such as primary status, selection, and read-only flag.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes a CalendarEvent to generate description and conditionally remove attendees based on settings.

methods.name: cleanIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Removes sensitive credential information from an integration object to prevent leaking credentials.

methods.name: getCalendarCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves calendar credentials from a list of CredentialForCalendarService objects.

methods.name: getCalendarCredentialsWithoutDelegation
methods.description: Retrieves calendar credentials excluding delegation credentials.

methods.name: getConnectedCalendars
methods.description: Fetches connected calendar instances, their primary calendars, and handles errors.

methods.name: deduplicateCredentialsBasedOnSelectedCalendars
methods.description: Removes duplicate credentials by considering delegation credentials and selected calendars.

methods.name: getBusyCalendarTimes
methods.description: Fetches busy times from calendars within a date range, handling deduplication and errors.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event, handling formatting, delegation, and error logging.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event, with error handling and warnings.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event, with logging and error handling.
